title: Hurricane Maria at Coast Guard Sector San Juan
description:
Lt. j.g. Josh McElhaney, situation unit leader for the Coast Guard Incident Command Post in Puerto Rico, listens to a teleconference with the 7th Coast Guard District and takes notes in the dark while Hurricane Maria passes over Puerto Rico, Sept. 20, 2017.
Coast Guardsmen in Puerto Rico sheltered in place to begin search and rescue efforts when the hurricane passes.

U.S. Coast Guard Video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Jonathan Lally.
